amendment_summary: Resolved transitive_suspect discrepancy: PM5/PM1/PP2 -> full ADR-0009 static-lineage set PS1/PM5/PM1/PP2/BP1 (BP1 is marker-invisible; omission would leak two scored ClinVar-derived criteria).
source_contract_corrections: audit/enforcement split: audit_lineage(records,policy,scorer_config,eval_config)->LineageAuditReport is total (always returns, blocked=True included, never raises on blockers); enforce_lineage(report)->None raises LineageGateError(report) iff blocked. Adapter: audit then enforce. CLI: audit, persist+print, then enforce/exit nonzero.

detection_source is advisory enum {static_lineage, marker_detected, transitive_suspect_only}, separate from policy lineage_class taxonomy; BP1 lineage_class=aggregate_clinvar, detection_source=transitive_suspect_only (exact test value).

markers vocab embedded directly in configs/eval/bias_lineage.yaml (single source of truth); configs/eval/clinvar_markers.yaml does not exist and is not referenced; every record's rationale_markers validated against embedded markers.

assert_registry_consistency also asserts set(scorer_config.acmg_criteria)==policy.can_fire (kind registry_can_fire_drift); corrected registry replaces phantom BS3/BS4 with source-derived PS3/BS2 (not included); included/automatable stay the 14-criterion subset; BS2 deferred.
authorized existing-config corrections: configs/acmg/tsc.yaml + configs/eval/tsc2.yaml only.

AC-L8 clarified against corrected config: scored requires_heldout_mask PS1/PM5/PM1/PP2/BP1 block+enforce raises; PS3/BS2 reported would_be_scored=False, do not block; direct-copy PS4/PP5/BP6 reported-not-scored.
CLI exact: positional BIAS TSV + required --output REPORT_JSON; stdout emits same canonical JSON; exit 0 clean / nonzero blocked; report always persisted; BiasTsvSource 18-column contract.
unknown/stub nonzero supplemental firing classified from the raw fired mapping (not gated on parse_rationale succeeding on unknown codes): audit reports+sets blocked, enforce raises.
disposition_rollup_note: label_independent + policy-approved (allowed) = 9; requires_heldout_mask = 5; forbidden = 3; deferred = 2 (PS3 assay-validity review; BS2 decision_dependency: bs2-policy — label-independent population/control source is not policy approval, so BS2 stays deferred and is NOT included/automatable by this task). Total = 19.

authorized_existing_config_corrections.configs/acmg/tsc.yaml: Remove BS3/BS4 from included_criteria (->14); replace BS3/BS4 acmg_criteria registry entries with source-derived PS3/BS2 (direction/strength-vocab only, not included) so acmg_criteria == can_fire (19). BS2 stays deferred.
authorized_existing_config_corrections.configs/eval/tsc2.yaml: Remove BS3/BS4 from automatable_criteria (keep included_criteria == automatable_criteria).

tester.responsibility: Author executable AC tests (AC-L1..AC-L13) from slot 2 + slot-1 source surfaces only, before the doer. Derive the can-fire oracle statically from pinned BIAS classifiers, never from the census or RAPTOR config. AC-L13 proves BS2 stays deferred (decision_dependency: bs2-policy) and cannot be included/scored without a separate named policy decision.

doer.responsibility: Implement the config + three modules + CLI to pass the tester's ACs, in sequence bias-lineage-policy -> bias-lineage-registry -> bias-lineage-audit. May add tests, never weaken; honor slot 3 preservation.

checker.responsibility: Re-verify all ACs pass, the frozen preservation set is byte-unchanged, and none of the four slot-3 inversion failures are present (static oracle, BP1 transitive net, no phantom-19, no lineage-laundering of BS2 source-independence into policy approval).
